=== CONCLUSION (BUG-052 runtime DOM) — 受限未验证, with the cause ===
The running default daemon (pid 46916) resolved and cached the AUP app at boot:
$ grep -n 'Resolved AUP app blocklet' /Users/shenxiuqiang/.afs/daemon.log | tail -1
3093:{"ts":"2026-09-28T16:18:44.574Z","level":"info","service":"arc-node","ns":"node:boot","message":"Resolved AUP app blocklet \"arcblog\" via AFS at /registry/blocklets/arcblog"}
$ grep -n 'dev watch' /Users/shenxiuqiang/.afs/daemon.log | tail -1
27:{"ts":"2026-09-28T16:15:42.013Z","level":"info","service":"arc-node","ns":"node:server","message":"dev watch (3): /Users/shenxiuqiang/.arc/versions/2.0.0-beta.50/assets/blocklets, /Users/shenxiuqiang/workspace/my-app, /Users/shenxiuqiang/workspace/ArcBlog"}
So after the .aup edit the still-running page keeps the OLD strings; measured:
  - arc dsl generate --write  -> locale JSON regenerated (new keys present)
  - arc blocklet build        -> dist rebuilt; diff -r .aup dist/.aup = EMPTY (exit 0)
  - arc blocklet run <repo>   -> remounted (3 attempts: 17:56, 18:02 + after the build)
  - touch .aup/pages/ops/media.aup -> no dev-watch event in daemon.log
  - CDP ?page=media (admin, fresh browser context) -> STILL the old strings (3/3 runs)

Making the change live requires restarting the default instance (4939), which L-R20-1 forbids.
REPRO (run after the round's legitimate restart, or on any freshly started instance):
  node /tmp/req022-media-dom.mjs    # one admin tab, Page.navigate, closes its own target
EXPECT: standingNoteLines = 2 entries (media.queue-standing-note + media.media-standing-note) and
        oldEmptyStateLines = [] .
